208994.overview: Paranormal is one of the early Zen Pinball original tables, first released in Zen Pinball for the PlayStation 3, and is also part of the 3-table Sci-Fi pack. It is a pinball table themed around various popular paranormal phenomena and efforts to ascertain their veracity.

208995.overview:
Pasha is a pinball table that was first released as one of the four tables exclusive to Pinball FX 2, made available for Zen Pinball 2 in 2015 and Pinball FX 3 on its release date as one of the four Zen original tables that are part of the Core Collection. This table is inspired by the magical fantasy world of the Middle Eastern folk tale compilation One Thousand and One Nights.

The name of the table, Pasha, refers to one of the table’s antagonists - named after a title bestowed upon high-ranking government officials of the Ottoman Empire.

208996.overview: Portal is a licensed pinball adaptation of Valve Corporation's Portal video game duology, known for its mix of platforming and physics-based puzzle-solving. Initially released in the spring of 2015 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3, this table recaptures the events of the 2011 sequel, Portal 2, in which the test subject Chell explores the Aperture Science Enrichment Center, using a portal gun and knowledge of physics to overcome obstacles, before eventually coming into conflict with the facility's malevolent supercomputer, GLaDOS.

448354.overview:
This game is based on Popcap's Plants vs. Zombies series. The player sides with the plants defending the garden against invading zombies. The game retains the concept of waves from tower defense games. By defeating zombies in various missions coins are earned that can be spent at Dave's Twiddy Dinkies for items that boost the score or provide bonuses.

The table has two regular flippers at the bottom, one at the top left, and one at the top right at a higher area. Access to the outlanes at the end of a ramp happens through a pool and a mailbox. A sunflower can be waken up to gather sun icons as a resource spent on various seed packets found through a flower pot on the left. The top right flipper is the only access to the Melon-Putt that can rain down melons on zombies. These zombies appear as 3D animated characters on the table. There is also a car that can be hit to open its trunk and lock the ball inside. After three locked balls multiball is activated. When all four main missions are completed, Dr. Zomboss at the back of the table is woken up. He spits huge balls of snow or fire defeating by selecting the appropriate ball through the flower pot.

460368.overview: Released in 1983 by Taito do Brasil, "Polar Explorer" is a solid-state pinball machine designed for up to four players. The game features an arctic exploration theme, challenging players to navigate treacherous ice and snow. Its playfield design is similar to Zaccaria's "Pinball Champ" from the same year.

468581.overview: Pinball Noir is one of the three Zen Originals that released with the launch of the Pinball FX reboot in March 2022. Inspired by noir films and stories from the 1940s, primarily The Maltese Falcon, the player takes the role of private eye Seamus as he takes down crooks and uncovers the mystery of the Fat Man.

468583.overview:
Snoopy was the first new Animated Heroes table released following the launch of Zen Pinball Party, originally released on October 29th, 2021, and subsequently ported to Pinball FX in February 2023. The table features Snoopy's many imaginary personas, including the Flying Ace and astronaut, and highlights his interactions with the rest of the gang from the Peanuts comic strip, such as Charlie Brown and Woodstock.

Snoopy was also the first Pinball FX table designed by Daniel "Dolby" Vigh.

468655.overview:
Go big or go extinct. Prime your senses for a neural handshake and step into the cockpit of a Jaeger. It is on you to cancel the apocalypse!

Table features:

- Strengthen the link between Raleigh and Mako by shooting the correct lanes in succession
- It's a Double Event! Battle two legendary Kaijus Leatherback and Otachi
- Drift with a Kaiju and uncover their secrets by hitting the bumpers
- Follow the General’s plan and navigate through deep waters to reach the Breach
- Overload the reactor of Gipsy Danger and lock your balls in the Core Lane for big points in Wizard Mode

468661.overview:
The Princess Bride Pinball - Not just your basic, average, every day, ordinary, run-of-the-mill, ho-hum pinball table. Jump into a world of treachery, peril, revenge... and a bit of kissing.

Table Features:

- Climb the Cliffs of Insanity and start a Duel with Inigo Montoya
- Give the right answer to Vizzini in the Battle of Wits mode and see your scores rise
- Free Westley from the Machine by shooting the lit lanes
- Prove your skill by going through the Super-Mega-Multi-Monster skillshots
- Storm the castle in the Wizard Mode and let true love prevail

468669.overview:
Find the real meaning of Christmas in A Charlie Brown Christmas Pinball! Join the Peanuts crew in putting on a play and decorating the most perfect tree there is.

Table features:

- Snowflakes fall on the playfield, shoot the ball to eat them before they melt
- Feed Snoopy a snack by shooting his bowl
- Choose the perfect Christmas tree by shooting the right lanes
- Decorate Snoopy's house in Multiball to win the Lights and Display contest
- Direct the play in the Wizard mode and bring the Peanuts crew together to celebrate!

470091.overview: Homebrew digital table for Virtual Pinball 9 based on the classic 1985 Atari arcade game.

470309.overview: This is a digital pinball table released for Visual Pinball X in 2024. It is a reskin of Gottlieb's 1985 pinball table "Rock" with the addition of many songs by The Police that can be cycled through whilst playing, by pressing the MAGNASAVE button (the right Ctrl button on the keyboard).

470425.overview:
The champion returns! Enhanced visuals and fluid gameplay push this classic to tournament-ready levels.

Pinball Champ 2018 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1982/83 solid state Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2018 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470857.overview:
The Prodigy are an English electronic dance music band formed in Braintree in 1990 by producer, keyboardist, and songwriter Liam Howlett. At their critical and commercial peak, the band also featured MC and lead vocalist Maxim, dancer and occasional live keyboardist Leeroy Thornhill, and dancer and occasional vocalist Keith Flint. They describe their style as electronic punk.

The Prodigy are one of the most successful electronic groups of all time, selling an estimated 25 million records worldwide including over 4.7 million albums in the UK. They have scored seven consecutive UK number one albums. 

This is a mod for Visual Pinball X of Gottlieb's 1979 "Count-Down".

470861.overview:
A colorful, amusement park-themed two-dimensional table with a playful atmosphere and compelling gameplay.

Party Land is one of four tables available in 21st Century Entertainment's renowned video game, Pinball Fantasies. First released for the Commodore Amiga in 1992, the game was later ported to a variety of other platforms, including Atari Jaguar (1995), SNES (1995), Nintendo Game Boy (1995), Sony Playstation (1996), and iOS (2009).

A three-dimensionally rendered remake was released by users "light66" & "Slippery Penguin" for Future Pinball in 2006.

470865.overview:
Warp speed ahead! Use the flippers to keep the ball in space.

Pinball-Planet is an all-wooden pinball game (including flippers and plunger) sold in Thailand c. 2000. 

A recreation of the table is available for Future Pinball.

470944.overview:
Pink Floyd are an English rock band formed in London in 1965 by Syd Barrett (guitar, vocals), Nick Mason (drums), Roger Waters (bass guitar, vocals) and Richard Wright (keyboards, vocals), with David Gilmour (guitar, vocals) joining at the end of 1967. Gaining an early following as one of the first British psychedelic groups, they were distinguished by their extended compositions, sonic experiments, philosophical lyrics, and elaborate live performances, and became a leading progressive rock band.

This is an unlicensed digital table by NitroNimbus first released for Future Pinball, and then later ported to Visual Pinball X.

471354.overview:
Billion Dollar Gameshow is a virtual pinball table known for its flashy TV quiz show theme and exceptionally high scoring potential, including a one billion point award. The table focuses on winning "prizes" through specific ramp and target combinations to build toward a massive jackpot. Players need to collect six high-value prizes (TV, Trip, Car, House, Boat, Plane) to light the Billion Dollar Award.

It is one of four tables available in 21st Century Entertainment's renowned video game, Pinball Fantasies. First released for the Commodore Amiga in 1992, the game was later ported to a variety of other platforms, including Atari Jaguar (1995), SNES (1995), Nintendo Game Boy (1995), Sony Playstation (1996), and iOS (2009).

A three-dimensionally rendered remake was released by users Sebek74, Slash2084, & Jerry Winter for Future Pinball in 2006.

471600.overview:
Speed Devils is one of the four iconic pinball tables featured in Pinball Fantasies, developed by Digital Illusions (later DICE) and released in 1992. It is a high-octane, fast-paced table with a motorsports theme, requiring players to master speed and timing to succeed. The primary goal is to simulate a car race by hitting targets, changing gears, and using ramps to overtake cars, ultimately aiming to reach top speed and take the lead position.

A three-dimensionally rendered remake was released by users "LvR" & "Moog" for Future Pinball in 2009.

471635.overview:
Ignition is the first table in the classic 1992 pinball simulation game Pinball Dreams, developed by Digital Illusions for the Amiga and later ported to other platforms. The table is themed around a rocket launch, planets, and space exploration.

A 3D version for the Future Pinball platform was created by users light66, Slash2084 & Sebek74.

471637.overview:
Beat Box is a notable table featured in the classic 1992 pinball simulation game Pinball Dreams, developed by Digital Illusions for the Amiga and later ported to various platforms. The table revolves around the theme of managing a struggling pop band, with objectives designed to help them achieve success. Gameplay involves advancing the band's career by securing deals, booking tours, and moving them up the charts.

A 3D version for the Future Pinball platform was created by users Slash2084 and Sebek74.

471638.overview:
Steel Wheel is one of the four original tables featured in the seminal 1992 pinball simulation game Pinball Dreams, developed by Digital Illusions. Themed around the Old West and steam-powered trains, it is considered the most accessible table for beginners among the four, featuring a welcoming design with accessible ramps.

The table features a brown and grey color scheme, with graphics focusing on steam trains, wild west imagery, and a banjo-heavy soundtrack. The layout of Steel Wheel is primarily based on the 1989 Williams "Bad Cats" real-world pinball table. The gameplay revolves around hitting the left and center ramps repeatedly to build up massive points and ticket values.

A 3D version for the Future Pinball platform was created by Misaligned Cow Venture, in addition to a Special Edition featuring more modern table artwork.

471639.overview:
Nightmare is widely considered the most challenging and atmospheric table in the classic 1992 pinball simulation game Pinball Dreams, developed by Digital Illusions. It is the fourth and final table in the set. Although listed as "Nightmare" in the menu, the playfield itself says "Graveyard." This inconsistency was addressed in some later ports, such as the Game Boy version, which renamed the table in the menu as "Graveyard".

The table is themed around a graveyard, ghosts, demons, and evil occurrences. It features dark, Gothic-inspired artwork with crosses, tombs, and eerie visuals, and it is known for having a very steep table design, making it difficult to keep the ball from moving quickly. The layout and some rules of this table are based on Williams' Terminator 2: Judgment Day pinball machine released a year earlier. 

The table is celebrated for having some of the best, most atmospheric music on the Amiga.

A 3D version for the Future Pinball platform was created by users Slash2084, Sebek74, Jerry Winter, and IamMrBongo.

471844.overview:
Stones 'n Bones is the fourth and final table in the classic 1992 pinball simulation game Pinball Fantasies, developed by Digital Illusions. It features a spooky, gothic horror theme complete with ghosts, bats, and a dark atmosphere.

A three-dimensionally rendered remake was released by user light86 for Future Pinball.

471851.overview:
Reborn madness! A fresh take on the classic with modern graphics and explosive fun.

POSTAL Redux: Remake is part of the POSTAL Redux Pinball Pack for Zaccaria Pinball, developed by Magic Pixel and released on December 17, 2021. It is a 90s-style pinball reimagining of the high-definition remake of the original controversial top-down shooter, POSTAL. 

This table features detailed table art, authentic audio call-outs, music, black comedy and dark themes of the POSTAL series.

471914.overview:
Deluxe devastation! The ultimate POSTAL 2 experience with upgraded visuals and intense gameplay.

POSTAL 2: Deluxe is a modern, high-intensity virtual table featuring multi-level playfields, detailed 3D design, and deep integration of the absurd black comedy from the POSTAL 2 video game. As the most modern ("Deluxe") style in the $7.99, four-table pack, it features an animated display, unique game modes, and iconic, often crude, references.

471939.overview:
Modern mayhem! Reimagined POSTAL 2 with sharp graphics and explosive features.

The POSTAL 2 Remake pinball table, part of Zaccaria Pinball's POSTAL 2 Table Pack on Steam, is a mature-themed, high-flow table developed by Magic Pixel. It features 3 flippers, 3 pop bumpers, 3 ramps, and 3D decorative objects themed around the game, such as a Mailbox, Christmas tree, and Meatworld. The table is known for having a "fun," fast-paced design with clear objectives.

471950.overview:
An original table by JP Salas for Visual Pinball X with a layout based on Stern's 2015 machine, Kiss.

The goal of the game is to achieve the highest score by catching Pokémon. Hatching eggs and catching Pokémon give the highest scores (and bonus). There are plenty of extra modes, with multiballs, combos, jackpots, and coins to upgrade your ball. The game includes all 151 Pokémon from Generation 1.

472354.overview:
As part of a deal with Bally, FarSight Studios licensed the 1994 table World Cup Soccer for inclusion in their Pinball Arcade game. However, FIFA were in an exclusive deal with EA regarding using World Cup branding in a video game. Consequently, FarSight had to change the name of the table to World Champion Soccer, and make a number of changes to the table artwork so it could be included in Pinball Arcade.

This digital table has many changes; the W-O-R-L-D-C-U-P lights leading to the left loop are replaced by C-H-A-M-P-I-O-N, World Cup USA 94 on the plastics between left in-lanes and out-lanes are renamed to Champion Soccer TPA 17. The backglass was also changed to avoid possible lawsuits from FIFA for using the tournament's mascot Striker, World Cup USA 94 name and any other references to World Cup USA 1994 without the required license.

473072.overview:
Pro-Football was released by Gottlieb in 1973. SLAMT1LT's ULTRA Edition for Future Pinball adds music, sound effects, and football commentary to enhance the sporting experience.

Rules:

 • Advancing the football 100 yards scores a Touchdown.
 • A Touchdown adds 6 to the point score and 6000 to the high score.
 • Football resets to the starting position when a Touchdown is made.
 • 1 replay is earned for matching the last two numbers in the high score to the number that appears on the back glass after the game is over.

473076.overview: This Future Pinball version of Data East's 1990 table has many improvements, including a new modern mode, an animated backglass, dynamic lightning, and better quality music and sound effects.

477186.overview:
Nintendo released Pinball for the NES in 1984, and it was an enjoyable, but fairly simple game, with the playfield split over two seperate screens, and a third screen showing a bonus Breakout-like mode.

The table has been recreated in 3D for Future Pinball, with full scrolling (unlike the original game's two-screen setup), enhanced graphics in the bonus stage (now placed in the backglass area of the table), and new Mario-themed in-game music and sound effects.

480128.overview:
Pepsiman is back - this time in a high-speed, soda-fueled pinball adventure! Dodge obstacles, collect Pepsi cans, and race against the clock in this action packed Visual Pinball X table based on the cult classic video game. Will you quench your thirst in time?

Pepsiman is an Ivan TBA mod of World Cup (Williams, 1978).

480197.overview: Pro Wrestling is a unique tribute for Future Pinball to the classic 1986 NES wrestling game. The game is filled with interesting ideas, giving players the feel of an 8-bit wrestling game by incorporating a wrestling ring as a second playfield at the top of the table. Shooting the ball into one of the holes in the wrestling ring will send the ball to the top of the ropes. The ball with then jump "off the ropes" back into the ring.

480478.overview:
Iconic English synth-pop duo the Pet Shop Boys have sold more than 100 million records worldwide, in a career spanning over 40 years. Now, thanks to Tony Fox, they have their first ever pinball game! 

Released for Visual Pinball X in 2025, Pet Shop Boys: Show is a mod of Fire Action De Luxe (Taito do Brasil, 1983) featuring beautiful playfield artwork, great gameplay, and a PuP pack featuring clips from their music videos, live performances, and even scenes from their terrible 1988 movie "It Couldn't Happen Here". The whole package comes together wonderfully, and is a worthy tribute that manages to live up to the band's enduring legacy and style.

480499.overview: An electromechanical-style table released in 2013 for Future Pinball based on the long-running comic superhero The Phantom. First published as a daily newspaper strip on February 17, 1936, the Phantom was the first fictional hero to wear the skintight costume which has become a hallmark of comic-book superheroes, and was the first shown in a mask with no visible pupils (another superhero standard).

480500.overview: The NitroNimbus mod of Daz's Future Pinball table adds music, a modern DMD, updated physics and better lighting to the game.

480628.overview: An original table for Visual Pinball 9, inspired by Stern's Pirates of the Caribbean (2006). The playfield artwork, layout and rules are similar to Stern's machine, but the music and sound effects are completely original. There are also some differences to the playfield: this table does not have any holes or saucers, so the ball is always moving.

480909.overview:
Prometheus is a 2012 science fiction horror film directed by Ridley Scott, and is the fifth installment of the Alien film series. Released the same year as the movie, this Future Pinball tribute is an original table by Jipar, and has an 'easy' and a 'hard' version.

PROMETHEUS (Easy Version) Rules:

1. Follow the GREEN LIGHTs to get URNS
2. Shoot all URNS to access TOP LEVEL (3 ways)
3. Light the 3 BLUE POINTS on the floor to trigger COBRALIENS
4. Shoot all COBRALIENS to open the ship's engineer GATE (floor)
5. Cross this GATE to trigger 2 contaminated TARGETS
6. Shoot these 2 contaminated to open the way of MED POD (red)
7. Go into the MED POD to extract the 'OCTOPUS' (TRILOBITE) and make it appear in the center, in front of the ENGINEER
8 .Enter the CENTRAL HOLE behind the 'OCTOPUS' to light the RAMP (orange light) of ship PROMETHEUS
9. Take RAMP (orange) to bring up the YOUNG ALIEN in the center
10. Enter the CENTRAL HOLE behind the ALIEN to open EXIT and escape to EARTH
11. Evacuate to the EARTH to complete the adventure PROMETHEUS

480913.overview:
Jipar's Predator is an original table for Future Pinball based on the classic 1987 movie starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as paramilitary soldier Dutch, battling to stay alive whilst trapped deep in the rainforest with an extraterrestrial predator.

Rules:
------

- Attack enemy camp (10.000 WL) to increase score muliplier (2x ...5x)

- Clear all soldiers-targets to begin invisible predator running (= 50.000 for each hit) and to open 2 gates.

- Lock 4 balls to start 'multiball' (500.000 + All targets hit when in multiball mode increase jackpot).

- Hit electric predator-target to raise the score. Receive currently lit score upon entering the door.

- Lock ball in the bottom of the door to start 'Predator Hunt' (hit each target as it pops up within 10 seconds). Mode ends if you fail to hit a target within the time limit. Score for succesful hit double each time up to a maximum of 1.000.000 per target.

- Clear the 4 trap-targets and open the trap: the predator is visible now = 100.000 each hit (4 max)

- After the trap, XB-target is ready to go to the hill for Dutch fight: clear all predator-targets and open the EXTRABALL gate on the top of the hill. First time = 1.000.000 + XB. The second time for Dutch victory = 10.000.000.

481001.overview:
Step into the eerie world of Stephen King's Pet Sematary with a terrifying pinball experience! Can you uncover the dark secrets of the cursed burial ground and escape before it's too late? This horror-filled machine brings spine-chilling excitement, supernatural surprises, and edge of your seat gameplay.

Pet Sematary for Visual Pinball X is a re-theme of Dracule (Stern, 1979) and is inspired by the 1989 movie adaptation of Stephen King's 1983 horror novel.

481003.overview: Alecia Beth Moore-Hart, known professionally as P!nk, is an American singer and songwriter. Phenom's P!nk table for Visual Pinball X is a re-theme of his previous Britney Spears table, using Diamond Lady (Gottlieb, 1988) as its source.
